bundle_cycle_lemma: Rotating bundles around a cycle of agents that each weakly prefer the next bundle preserves EFX and floater nonenvy; if one preference is strict, Nash welfare strictly increases.
claim_boundary: The reduction forces a floater-support edge but does not yet prove that repeated support edges close into an improving exchange.

graph.property: every acyclic strict-envy digraph has an unenvied bundle

source_host_corollary: The strict-envy graph of a maximum-Nash eligible state is acyclic. It has an unenvied host bundle. If floater insertion at that host is blocked, every blocking removed-good witness uses an old host good that the observer values strictly below the floater.
